A '''battle droid sergeant''' was present on Ryloth, along with [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|Droid]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]]. The droid was used as a test by TX-20 to see if the [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurrs]] would require organic meat only or not, the sergeant survived the test and verified TX-20's theory.
